teaching.theme: Daily Routines & Time（日常作息与时间）
key_points: 一般现在时描述日常：I wake up / I eat breakfast / I go to school
时间表达：in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
频率副词：always / usually / sometimes / never
What time do you...? 句型

timeline.title: 开场问候
timeline.detail: How are you? → What day is today? → What did you do yesterday?

timeline.title: 日常作息词汇
timeline.detail: wake up / brush teeth / eat breakfast / go to school / do homework / go to bed

timeline.title: 时间段表达
timeline.detail: in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening / at night

timeline.title: 频率副词练习
timeline.detail: I always brush my teeth / I usually eat breakfast / I sometimes watch TV

timeline.title: What time 句型 · 总结
timeline.detail: What time do you wake up? → I wake up at 7 o'clock.

strengths: 日常作息词汇掌握好，能自主造句
时间段表达 in the morning/afternoon 准确
频率副词 always/usually 使用正确
weaknesses: 第三人称单数 he/she + 动词-s 遗漏（He eat → He eats）
at night 与 in the night 混淆
What time 疑问句语序不稳定
performance.teacher_comment: Mera 对日常作息话题非常熟悉，能主动扩展回答。第三人称单数是本节课的主要挑战。

mastered: 日常作息词汇（wake up / brush teeth / eat breakfast）
in the morning / in the afternoon
needs_review: at night（不是 in the night）
What time do you...? 语序

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What time do you wake up?

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What does your mom do in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: Do you always brush your teeth?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: Yes, I always brush my teeth in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What do you do at night?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: I read books in the night.

vocab_fill.question: I _____ up at 7 o'clock every day.

sentence_making.prompt: 用 always 描述你每天做的事
sentence_making.example_answer: I always brush my teeth in the morning.

sentence_making.prompt: 用第三人称描述：mom / cook / breakfast / morning
sentence_making.example_answer: My mom cooks breakfast in the morning.

qa_practice.question: What time do you go to bed?
qa_practice.answer: I go to bed at 9 o'clock at night.

qa_practice.question: Do you always do your homework?
qa_practice.answer: Yes, I always do my homework in the afternoon.
